result.citation: Boston City Code §§ 10-11.4, 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
result.citation_basis: § 10-11.4: O070; § 10-11.7: O070, D013, D014; name 'Housing Stability Notification Act': O070 (heading 10-11)
result.note: The card's rule combines the notice requirement (§ 10-11.4) with enforcement and the $300/day fine (§ 10-11.7), so both sections are now cited; no quote is given because O070 is the ordinance as filed in council, not the enacted text, and D013 and D014 are agency pages.
